meta.name: cocoindex
meta.description: Comprehensive toolkit for developing with the CocoIndex library. Use when users need to create data transformation pipelines (flows), write custom functions, or operate flows via CLI or API. Covers building ETL workflows for AI data processing, including embedding documents into vector databases, building knowledge graphs, creating search indexes, or processing data streams with incremental updates.

copy.tagline: 构建 AI 数据处理管道，嵌入文档到向量库或知识图谱。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用 Python 搭建 ETL 流程处理 AI 数据。
